title: 150万美国人或请假：只为等GTA6发售，史上最贵游戏值不值？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: The video game calendar is usually a knife fight for prime launch windows.
segments.zh: 游戏发售档期通常争夺激烈。

segments.en: This year, though, it looked more like a bomb scare. The sixth installment of the wild and popular Grand Theft Auto series will be officially released on November 19th.
segments.zh: 但今年更像一场惊吓。热门系列《侠盗猎车手》第六部将于11月19日正式发售。

segments.en: The developers have been avoiding releasing games during this period.
segments.zh: 开发商一直避免在此期间发布游戏。

segments.en: Grand Theft Auto 6 is going to be a black hole of people's attention, of people's money, of people's time.
segments.zh: 《侠盗猎车手6》将像黑洞般吸走人们的注意力、金钱和时间。

segments.en: There's interesting estimates that suggest 1.5 million Americans might call insect on November 19th.
segments.zh: 有趣的是，有估计称11月19日可能有150万美国人请假。

segments.en: But Grand Theft Auto 6 launches into an industry racked by mass layoffs, consolidation, and a growing addiction to safe bets.
segments.zh: 但《侠盗猎车手6》进入的是一个受大规模裁员、整合和日益依赖安全押注困扰的行业。

segments.en: Since 2000, the number of top 20 games based on original IP has fallen, and GTA 6 is under
segments.zh: 自2000年以来，基于原创IP的前20名游戏数量下降，而《侠盗猎车手6》正面临

segments.en: the immense dual pressure of unprecedented capital outlay.
segments.zh: 前所未有的资本支出带来的巨大双重压力。

segments.en: By most estimates, it is the most expensive video game ever developed and crushing sales expectations.
segments.zh: 据多数估计，它是史上开发成本最高的电子游戏，销售预期也极高。

segments.en: You might be one of the most commercially successful media installments of all time.
segments.zh: 它可能成为有史以来商业上最成功的媒体产品之一。

segments.en: So how did GTA developer Rockstar secure a license to loot the corporate bank vault?
segments.zh: 那么GTA开发商Rockstar是如何获得许可，得以从公司金库中大肆敛财的？

segments.en: And where does it fit in an industry? It's upended.
segments.zh: 它在一个被颠覆的行业中处于什么位置？

segments.en: Grand Theft Auto is a pop culture phenomenon of a video game.
segments.zh: 《侠盗猎车手》是一款现象级的流行文化电子游戏。
